title: Tuple with Same Product
description: Given an array nums of distinct positive integers, return the number of tuples (a, b, c, d) such that a * b = c * d where a, b, c, and d are elements of nums, and a != b != c != d.
constraints: All elements in nums are distinct.
hints: Note that all of the integers are distinct. This means that each time a product is formed it must be formed by two unique integers.
Count the frequency of each product of 2 distinct numbers. Then calculate the permutations formed.
